verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI specification ([lobe-chat-docs-39], [lobe-chat-docs-10]), and a probe confirms a live openapi.json, so a machine-readable API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference rendered as an interactive explorer or offering runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer UI, runnable or try-it-now examples, code samples per endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration.
